At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:

**Engineering Manager

__

**Your role and tasks

**We are looking for a senior cyber security engineering authority who will take technical ownership of OT cyber security and technical decision-making across project and service assignments within the Oil and Gas and Power-to-X sectors. You will join our Cyber and Network team, working with system architecture and helping customers maintain reliable operations where shutdowns are not an option. The role combines technical engineering, troubleshooting, customer dialogue, and on-site delivery. You will collaborate with project managers, supply chain, manufacturing, and engineering colleagues to ensure that solutions meet contractual, safety, quality, and cybersecurity requirements. You will also contribute to documentation, technical risk assessments, proposals, and the continuous improvement of engineering tools and processes.

**Your Responsibilities Will Include

**

• Lead the technical dialogue in customer and project meetings to resolve technical issues and ensure contractual requirements are met.

• Own, review, and approve cyber security-related technical project deliverables, including the configuration and validation of security components.

• Design and harden system architectures according to the Purdue model.

• Design and configure firewall rules and network switches.

• Identify and resolve network issues affecting operational technology equipment.

• Provide technical support and execute testing, installation, commissioning, and service activities.

• Prepare and maintain project documentation, including as-built engineering deliverables.

• Coordinating with project, supply chain, manufacturing, and testing teams to deliver solutions on time and within scope.

**Qualifications For The Role

**

• The role requires the ability to lead technical clarification, make sound risk-based decisions, coach project engineers, review deliverables, and drive continuous improvement within normal project scope, secure service execution, and ABB governance.

• Ability to scale cybersecurity requirements to fit customer expectations and budget.

• Experience in network and cybersecurity engineering within operational technology environments.

• Practical experience with network architecture, firewalls, switches, system hardening, and patching.

• Industry knowledge relevant to critical infrastructure and environments where continuous operation is essential.

• Ability to analyze technical issues, advise customers on suitable and reliable solutions, and present technical solutions in sales meetings, project meetings, or conferences.

• Good communication skills and the ability to build close dialogue with different stakeholders.

• Fluent Danish, both written and spoken.

**More About Us

**At ABB, we have a clear goal of promoting diversity and inclusion in terms of gender, LGBTQ+, disability, ethnicity, and age. Together, we have embarked on a journey where we all individually and collectively celebrate and welcome individual differences. You can look forward to joining an organization that emphasizes employee well-being. Collaboration and team spirit are key words for us and a crucial foundation for reaching our shared goals. We prioritize a good working environment highly and continuously invest in the education and development of you and your colleagues. If you want to read more about our continuous work with the working environment and sustainability, you can find more information at: https://global.abb/group/en/sustainability

You can be based at either our Middelfart or Ballerup office. As the rest of the team is located in Middelfart, you should be comfortable collaborating closely across locations if you are based in Ballerup. The role also includes work at offshore customer sites in Denmark and Qatar and at onshore customer sites across Denmark, particularly in critical infrastructure environments, and some travel should be expected.

The position reports to Engineering Manager, Ricky Lausen.

Apply for the job online via our simple and easily accessible system, where you can also sign up to receive notifications on other opportunities within ABB. If you have questions about the position before then, you are welcome to contact Ricky Lausen at +45 26 80 26 62.

The application deadline is 02.12.2026. We look forward to receiving your application.

_ABB is a global technology leader in electrification and automation, enabling a more sustainable future with efficient use of resources. By connecting our knowledge in engineering and digitalization, ABB makes industry more efficient, productive, sustainable, and able to improve their performance. At ABB, we call it 'Engineered to Outrun'. The company has over 140 years of history and more than 110,000 employees worldwide. In Denmark, you will have more than 550 colleagues in offices in Ballerup, Middelfart, Esbjerg, Kalundborg and Aalborg.

__Join us. Be part of the team where progress takes place, industries transform, and your work shapes the world.

__Run What Runs the World.

__#RunWithABB

_Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

**About us:

**Founded in Copenhagen, Denmark, in 2014, Templafy’s success is built by our 60+ employee nationalities found at offices around the world. We believe that when people feel valued, heard, and empowered, they perform at their best—creating a win for all. Our unique product and dedication to innovation and excellence have raised over $200 million in funding from top investors like Insight Venture Partners, Seed Capital, Dawn Capital, Damgaard Company and Golub Capital.

Role Summary

As Corporate Security Engineer at Templafy, you will help secure the corporate technology foundation of a global SaaS company building AI-powered document generation and business content solutions. You will take responsibility for protecting the systems, identities, devices, networks, and SaaS platforms that enable our teams to operate securely at scale.

This is a hands-on engineering role where you will design and operate controls across identity, endpoints, email, data protection, cloud, and SaaS governance. As a technical security partner, you will contribute to corporate infrastructure decisions and help shape how Templafy protects its business operations as the company grows.

You will collaborate closely with IT, Security, Legal, Privacy, and business stakeholders. A separate Senior Information Security Analyst is responsible for application and product security and incident response. This role complements that work by strengthening the corporate environment that supports the wider business.

What Will Help You Succeed

You have experience in corporate or infrastructure security and enjoy building, hardening, automating, and continuously improving systems.

You use sound judgment to assess risk, make pragmatic technical decisions, and determine when broader input is needed. You are comfortable working across technical and non-technical teams and can translate security requirements into practical solutions that people can understand and adopt.

You enjoy improving systems through automation, scripting, and thoughtful workflow design. You are comfortable taking responsibility for security initiatives while collaborating with colleagues when decisions require broader input. You will have the opportunity to work across several technical areas and help shape our corporate security practices as our technology and business evolve.

Key Responsibilities

• Identity and access security — Design and operate controls across the identity layer, including JIT/PAM, Conditional Access, OAuth scope reviews, and SSO enforcement.

• Endpoint and platform security — Implement and operate the Microsoft 365 Defender suite, harden endpoints, and manage patching and remediation across Windows, macOS, and corporate applications.

• Data protection — Implement and manage data loss prevention controls and configure backup solutions, such as Keepit, for corporate and SaaS data.

• Network and email security — Deploy and maintain firewalls, egress filtering, network segmentation, anti-phishing controls, and email authentication standards including DMARC, DKIM, and SPF.

• SaaS governance — Discover and govern shadow IT and unsanctioned SaaS or AI usage, and support effective application patching and lifecycle management.

• Security automation — Automate routine IT and security operations, including lifecycle workflows, compliance checks, access reviews, asset discovery, and data classification. Build scripting-based tools using PowerShell or Python and use appropriate automation and agentic tooling to improve manual workflows.

• Security advisory — Partner with the IT Administrator on security-related decisions, provide technical input on vendor assessments and integration reviews, and advise teams across the business on infrastructure security.

• Incident support — Investigate incidents involving corporate infrastructure in coordination with the Senior Information Security Analyst.

**Required Qualifications

**

• Relevant experience in corporate security engineering, infrastructure security, or a combined IT and security role, typically gained through four or more years of professional experience.

• Experience taking responsibility for at least one security domain—such as identity, endpoint, network, or data protection—from design and implementation through to ongoing operation and improvement.

• Practical experience implementing and operating an enterprise identity provider, including Conditional Access, privileged access controls, SSO, and MFA. Experience with Entra ID is preferred, but experience with platforms such as Okta or an equivalent solution is also relevant.

• Production experience implementing and operating at least one of the following: data loss prevention, network segmentation, or egress filtering.

• The ability to assess risk, evaluate trade-offs, and make clear, defensible prioritisation decisions.

• Scripting and automation skills using PowerShell, Python, or a comparable language, with examples of improving or replacing manual workflows.

• Experience scoping, coordinating, and delivering security projects involving multiple teams or business functions.

• Experience communicating security decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Experience working in a technology-led or similarly complex environment. Familiarity with B2B SaaS is beneficial but not essential.

**Preferred Qualifications

**

• Certifications such as CISSP, GSEC, Azure Security Engineer Associate, or equivalent knowledge developed through practical experience.

• Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or NIST CSF.

• Experience with SaaS backup solutions such as Keepit, Veeam, or an equivalent platform.

**

• Private health insurance

• Company lunch contribution

• Phone and broadband covered by company

• Centrally located office – easy access to public transportation

• Company events and team activities

• Flexible work environment

At Genmab, we are dedicated to building extra[not]ordinary® futures, together, by developing antibody products and groundbreaking, knock-your-socks-off KYSO antibody medicines® that change lives and the future of cancer treatment and serious diseases. We strive to create, champion and maintain a global workplace where individuals’ unique contributions are valued and drive innovative solutions to meet the needs of our patients, care partners, families and employees.

Our people are compassionate, candid, and purposeful, and our business is innovative and rooted in science. We believe that being proudly authentic and determined to be our best is essential to fulfilling our purpose. Yes, our work is incredibly serious and impactful, but we have big ambitions, bring a ton of care to pursuing them, and have a lot of fun while doing so.

Does this inspire you and feel like a fit? Then we would love to have you join us!

**Role

**With a clear strategy of becoming an integrated end-to-end biotech innovation powerhouse, Genmab is directly involved in the commercialization of our products. To further strengthen the Quality Assurance Commercial & Lifecycle team located in Denmark and the United States, we are looking for a Senior Manager, Quality Assurance (QA) to join our Good Distribution Practice (GDP) team in Denmark.

As Senior Manager, QA - GDP, you will play an important role in ensuring quality and compliance across Genmab’s global commercial distribution network. You will have a broad and hands-on role covering storage and distribution activities, vendor oversight and cross-functional projects, working closely with international vendors and partners as well as stakeholders across QA, Supply Chain and Commercial Operations. Auditing is a significant part of the role, and you will conduct GxP audits of external vendors and partners across our global network. The role requires approximately 50% international travel to vendors and partners, primarily in connection with GxP audits. We are looking for an experienced QA professional who is comfortable taking ownership and navigating new or unfamiliar areas. As a Senior Manager, you will also act as a subject matter resource within your areas of responsibility, providing quality guidance and advice to stakeholders and contributing to compliant and risk-based decision-making.

This is an individual contributor role at Senior Manager level. The position is based in Denmark and reports to the Director of QA GMP, Commercial & Lifecycle - Storage and Distribution.

**Responsibilities

**

• Plan and conduct GxP audits of external vendors and partners and contribute to audit planning, follow-up and continuous improvement based on audit observations and trends.

• Take ownership of vendor oversight activities, including vendor risk evaluations, quality agreements and follow-up on the performance and compliance of GDP vendors.

• Independently manage operational GDP quality activities, including external notifications, change controls, deviations and other quality issues involving external partners.

• Participate in and support recall operations for the EU market in collaboration with the global QA GMP team and external partners.

• Contribute to shipping lane validation/qualification and perform GDP risk assessments related to storage, transportation and supply chain operations.

• Contribute to the implementation and continuous improvement of quality systems, SOPs and work instructions.

• Represent QA GDP in cross-functional and global projects, taking ownership of QA deliverables within assigned areas.

• Perform shipment release and support EU serialization activities.

• Support implementation and maintenance of GDP training.

• Participate in regulatory inspections and internal audits.

• Maintain knowledge of new and updated GDP regulations and guidelines and translate relevant requirements into practice.

• Collaborate closely with Supply Chain, Commercial Operations and other stakeholders to ensure compliant distribution practices.

• Handle and contribute to continuous improvement of Product Complaint intake and investigations.

• Take on new quality topics and assignments as business needs evolve, independently building the knowledge and stakeholder network needed to bring activities forward.

**Requirements

**

• Bachelor’s or master’s degree in science or related field.

• You have 8+ years of experience within the pharmaceutical or biotech industry, with significant experience within Quality Assurance and GxP. Experience within GDP and commercial distribution is preferred but not required.

• You have solid experience conducting GxP audits and are comfortable acting as an auditor. Audit experience is a requirement for this position.

• You are proactive, curious and comfortable taking ownership of assignments, independently navigating new or unfamiliar areas and finding solutions where the way forward is not predefined.

• You have strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills and can establish effective relationships across functions, geographies and with external partners.

• You communicate confidently in English and are comfortable asking questions, challenging constructively and making quality decisions within your area of responsibility.

• You must already be based in Denmark at the time of application, and you are willing to travel approximately 50% of the time across Europe, the United States, and the rest of the world on a long-term basis.

**About You

**

• You are genuinely passionate about our purpose.

• You bring precision and excellence to all that you do.

• You believe in our rooted-in-science approach to problem-solving.

• You take pride in enabling the best work of others on the team.

• You can grapple with the unknown and be innovative.

• You have experience working in a fast-growing, dynamic company (or a strong desire to).

The proposed gross annual/hourly base salary range for this position, in the primary location, based on a full time schedule is:

DKK607.920,00---911.880,00

The final salary offer will depend on several factors, including your skills, qualifications, and experience.

In addition to base salary, this position is eligible for additional forms of compensation, such as discretionary bonuses and long-term incentives.

**Benefits

**When you join Genmab, you become a part of a culture that supports your physical, financial, social, and emotional well-being. Our benefits include, but are not limited to:

• Pension

• Health insurance and wellness benefits

• Paid time off

• Employee support programs

Further details on eligibility for compensation and benefits based on the role will be provided during the recruitment process.

**About Genmab

**Genmab is an international biotechnology company with a core purpose to improve the lives of patients through innovative and differentiated antibody therapeutics. For 25 years, its hard-working, innovative and collaborative team has invented next-generation antibody technology platforms and harnessed translational, quantitative and data sciences, resulting in a proprietary pipeline including bispecific T-cell engagers, antibody-drug conjugates, next-generation immune checkpoint modulators and effector function-enhanced antibodies. By 2030, Genmab’s vision is to transform the lives of people with cancer and other serious diseases with Knock-Your-Socks-Off (KYSO®) antibody medicines.

Established in 1999, Genmab is headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark with international presence across North America, Europe and Asia Pacific. For more information, please visit Genmab.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

Genmab is committed to protecting your personal data and privacy. Please see our privacy policy for handling your data in connection with your application on our website Job Applicant Privacy Notice (genmab.com).

atNorth is a leading Nordic data center company providing cost-effective, scalable high-density colocation and built-to-suit services to industry-leading organizations across Iceland, Sweden, Finland, and Denmark.

With sustainability at our core, our data centers run on renewable energy and are designed according to circular economy principles. Through innovative design, power efficiency, and intelligent operations, we deliver reliable, secure, and high-performance infrastructure.

Headquartered in Reykjavik, Iceland, atNorth operates eight data centers across the Nordics, with additional sites under development in Finland, Denmark, Sweden and Norway.

We combine world-class technology with a people-first culture built on collaboration, ownership, and trust, empowering our teams to grow, take responsibility, and make a real impact.

By joining our international team, you will help shape the future of sustainable digital infrastructure.

**Senior Technical Lead - Electrical at atNorth

**Are you a seasoned electrical engineering expert with a passion for delivering and operating world-class data centre infrastructure? At atNorth, you'll play a pivotal role in shaping the next generation of sustainable, high-performance data centres across the Nordics.

As the technical authority for electrical systems and critical power infrastructure, you will provide expert guidance across both project delivery and operations, ensuring technical excellence, engineering integrity, and operational reliability throughout the asset lifecycle.

This is a unique opportunity to combine deep technical expertise with strategic influence, working closely with Operations, Design, Development, and industry-leading specialists to drive innovation in one of the fastest-growing sectors in Europe.

**Key responsibilities:

**

• Act as the technical lead and authority and signatory for electrical engineering designs, calculations, specifications, standards, and operational procedures.

• Provide expert leadership across critical electrical infrastructure, including LV and MV distribution systems, UPS systems, generators, batteries, protection systems, and associated controls.

• Drive design reviews, engineering assurance, commissioning activities, and technical handovers to ensure operational readiness and long-term reliability.

• Develop and maintain engineering standards, technical specifications, operational procedures, and best-practice frameworks across atNorth's Nordic data centre portfolio.

• Collaborate closely with Design, Development, and Operations teams to ensure seamless integration of new infrastructure and effective transition into operations.

• Lead technical investigations, troubleshooting efforts, and root-cause analyses for complex electrical incidents and performance issues.

• Serve as the primary electrical engineering advisor for internal stakeholders, clients, consultants, and vendors.

• Evaluate emerging technologies and industry developments, supporting innovation within critical power systems and data centre infrastructure.

• Drive training, technical mentoring, and knowledge sharing across operational and engineering teams to strengthen capability and consistency.

• Support asset lifecycle planning, maintenance strategies, resilience improvements, and continuous improvement initiatives across the portfolio.

**Your profile:

**

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related discipline.

• Minimum 10 years of experience in electrical engineering, critical infrastructure, or mission-critical environments, including progression into senior technical leadership roles.

• Extensive experience delivering data centre engineering projects, with deep expertise in critical electrical infrastructure, including LV and MV distribution, UPS systems, generators, batteries, protection systems, and power quality management.

• Strong understanding of commissioning, system integration, operational readiness, maintenance strategies, and asset lifecycle management.

• Proven experience acting as a technical authority, reviewing and approving engineering designs, technical documentation, specifications, and operational standards.

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to translate complex technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Fluent English and willingness to travel across the Nordic region as required.

**About the atNorth Culture

**We believe that sustainable success starts with the wellbeing of our people. For us, an open, transparent, and inclusive culture is more than a priority, it is the core of how we lead and innovate.

We don’t just talk about culture; we nurture it. Through regular one-to-one engagements and monthly wellbeing surveys, we listen carefully to our teams, ensuring that every voice is heard and every opportunity for improvement is embraced.

We recognize that innovation and collaboration thrive where people feel truly connected, which is why we come together each week to share ideas, strengthen relationships, and nurture a sense of belonging, sometimes over a simple breakfast and good conversation.

At atNorth, we are building a community where you can do your best work and shape a sustainable future together. #99

Are you passionate or curious about cutting-edge optics and photonics? Do you want to help manufacture the world’s best spectrometers – and make a real difference in industries ranging from green energy to healthcare?

Join Ibsen Photonics – a global leader in optical innovation.

We’re looking for talented production engineers to join our Engineering team, where we support, validate and continuously improve the production of our transmission grating based spectrometers in collaboration with international customers.

Why join us?

At Ibsen Photonics, we combine world-class technology with a strong sense of purpose. Our products help advance green energy, improve healthcare diagnostics, and enable innovation across a wide range of industries.

Since 2014, we have 5-folded our revenue, reaching annual sales of more than 200 MDKK. We are 100 dedicated colleagues working from our R&D and manufacturing facility in Farum, just outside Copenhagen.

We offer:

• An important role in a fast-growing, financially strong company

• A culture built on trust, collaboration, freedom with responsibility, and swift decision-making

• An innovation-driven workplace where your ideas matter – and where you will see them come to life

Your role: Production Engineer in the Spectrometer production

You will join our 7-person Spectrometer Engineering team. We are a cross-disciplinary team taking pride in combining our individual expertise to achieve the best. Your tasks will primarily be related to supporting and improving our spectrometer production. Every spectrometer leaving our facility is thoroughly tested, and you will play an important role in improving and maintaining our optical test setups and automated test software.

Your tasks will include:

• Contributing to New Product Introductions

• Innovating established processes in order to increase our capabilities while improving robustness.

• Troubleshoot, correct and prevent production issues

• Validation and statistical analysis

• Quality Assurance support and documentation

What you bring

We are looking for someone who is both technically strong and possess the curiosity and drive to immerse yourself in the wonderful world of photonics. Whether you have many years of industry experience or are starting your career, we look forward to integrate your skills in our department.

You are required to have

• An M.Sc. degree in Engineering, Physics or similar

• Hands-on experience with opto-mechanical assemblies or experimental optics work

• Coding proficiency in eg. Python, MatLab or LabVIEW for test automation and data analysis.

• A structured, analytical approach to problem-solving and quality assurance

• A proactive mindset and a desire to reach goals in collaboration

• Oral and written proficiency in Danish.

Ideally you also have

• Experience from a volume manufacturing environment

• Routine in carrying out validation activities

• Insight into detectors and electronics

What we offer

• Flexible working hours

• A culture where everyone contributes to a shared goal – and takes pride in the result

• A friendly, respectful work environment with regular social events

• Competitive salary and benefits (details can be discussed during the interview)

Ready to make a difference?

If you believe you are the right candidate for the position, click the application link to apply on our website. We are looking to recruit as soon as possible but will keep the position open until we have found the right candidate. If you want more information about the position, please call Morten Mechlenborg on +45 4290 1466 or email morten.mechlenborg@ibsen.com.

About Ibsen Photonics

Ibsen’s core technology is optical transmission gratings and grating based spectrometers, which we design, manufacture and supply to customers worldwide. Our spectrometers find their way into medical devices and scientific instruments used in sustainable energy, industrial, pharmaceutical, life sciences, security, and many other applications.

We work closely with our customers to create value adding solutions, sharing our extensive technical knowledge in an open and honest work environment with a flat “Scandinavian” hierarchical structure.

You will join a rapidly growing company employing 85 people at our facility just north of Copenhagen, and realising a turnover of more than 150 MDKK in 2023. We work actively with the UN’s Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and strive to make our business fully sustainable.

Ibsen Photonics is majority owned N. Foss & Co. A/S, a world leader in analytical solutions for the agricultural industry, with an annual turnover of 2.5 Billion DKK and more than 1.800 employees.

**Security and Fire Specialist, Denmark

****Lyngby, Odense, Vejle, Esbjerg, Aarhus, Aalborg

**Full-time Permanent

Hybrid

Are you a fire protection and security systems specialist looking to develop robust technical solutions within one of Denmark’s largest electrical engineering teams in Buildings and Industry? Do you thrive on thoughtful building design, reliable systems and multidisciplinary collaboration across a diverse project portfolio? If so, we would like to hear from you.

**Create the solutions that enable a better tomorrow

**We are seeking a Senior Security and Fire Specialist to strengthen our expertise in security and fire protection systems for complex projects that support essential societal functions. You will join COWI’s Buildings and Industry division, where approximately 500 specialists work with clients on some of the most significant projects in Denmark and internationally.

You will be part of an international network of specialists, collaborating closely with colleagues across disciplines and countries. With a primary focus on fire protection and security systems, you will play a key technical role in both your own assignments and larger multidisciplinary projects. Sustainability and digital development are priorities at COWI, and an interest in integrating these perspectives into your work would be an advantage.

We welcome candidates from a range of professional backgrounds. As a large electrical engineering discipline within Buildings and Industry, we bring together diverse skills and experience, united by a commitment to collaboration, integrity and a positive working environment. You may have a qualification in electrical installation, electrical engineering, marine and technical engineering, or a related field.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Working with fire protection and security systems, including ABA, ABDL, AVA, ABV, ADK, AIA and TVO

• Preparing project documentation throughout all phases of major construction projects

• Providing technical consultancy, design, specifications and tender documentation for security and fire protection systems

• Undertaking project follow-up, site supervision and commissioning of security and fire protection systems

• Developing and sharing best practice, exchanging knowledge and maintaining up-to-date technical expertise within the discipline

**Your skills. Our team. Together, we design the future.

**The first step to success in this role is that you are eager to collaborate with the people around you, whether they are colleagues, partners or customers. Developing ties with others is something you do by acting respectfully and delivering on your promises. And you never get set in your ways but keep exploring new insights and ways to improve.

You will also bring

• In-depth knowledge of security and fire protection systems, gained through practical experience, formal education or a combination of both; your specific educational background is not a determining factor

• The ability to communicate clearly, precisely and unambiguously in both written and spoken English and Danish

• Recent, relevant experience with security and fire protection systems

• Ideally, more than 10 years of experience providing consultancy on security and fire protection systems

• Knowledge of CER and NIS2 would be an advantage

• The ability to obtain security clearance to at least HEM (SECRET) level

**A place to work – and so much more

**At COWI, we work together with our customers to shape a sustainable and liveable world. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in Scandinavia, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

**Do you have more questions?

**For more information about the position and what we offer, please contact Priyanka, our Global Talent Acquisition Specialist, at prki@cowi.com.

Learn more about our projects, strategy, ambitions and life at COWI at www.cowi.com.

We are committed to a fair and unbiased recruitment process. To support this, please do not include a photograph in your CV.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, and inclusion is integral to the way we work.

jobs.occupation: PhD in modelling and experiments on PEM electrolysis
jobs.description:
At the Faculty of Engineering and Science, AAU Energy, a position as PhD stipend is available within the general study program. The stipend is open for appointment from January 1st or soon hereafter. The duration of the position is three years.

Your work tasks

The position is offered in relation to the research group "Hydrogen and Electro Fuels" and the PhD Student will be positioned to the section for “Thermal Engineering”.

Your competencies As a PhD student in modelling and experiments on PEM water electrolysis, you will work at the intersection of chemical and electrochemical reactor engineering, with a particular emphasis on electrolysis. The project focuses on testing proton exchange membrane electrolysis cells, characterising their electrochemical performance and developing detailed electrochemical cell models. You will design and carry out experiments on single cells, analyse electrochemical behaviour under different operating conditions and use the resulting data to build, calibrate and validate mechanistic models that describe transport, kinetics and degradation phenomena.

An important part of your work will be to investigate how PEM electrolysers perform when conventional materials are partially replaced by recycled ionomers and iridium. You will compare performance, stability and degradation patterns with and without recycled components and translate your findings into a deeper understanding of the underlying electrochemical mechanisms. In parallel, you will conduct techno‑economic assessments of PEM electrolysis systems, including related life cycle assessment studies, to evaluate how material choices, operating strategies and system design affect costs and environmental impacts over the full life cycle.

The PhD project is carried out in the context of the CYCLOPEM, EDSOES and CAPEX projects, which provide access to state‑of‑the‑art experimental facilities and collaboration with academic and industrial partners. You are expected to participate in project meetings and to present your results at international conferences and workshops. In addition, you will contribute to teaching activities within courses on chemical and electrochemical reactors and take part in the daily activities of the Hydrogen and Electro Fuels research group at AAU Energy, including group meetings, seminars and joint publications.

The applicant must have a relevant professional and/or educational background within thermal, chemical and electrochemical engineering. Modelling of chemical and electrochemical reactor and LCA.

**Qualification requirements

**PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 872 of 6 October 2026 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

**Who we are

**AAU Energy is a research department at Aalborg University dedicated to the development of clean

and sustainable energy systems. Our activities cover electrical, thermal and mechatronic energy technologies, and we work closely with industrial partners and other academic environments to address real‑world energy challenges.

The department is located in both Aalborg and Esbjerg, and this position is based at the Aalborg/Esbjerg campus. AAU Energy employs around 250 staff members at different career stages and from a broad range of national backgrounds. This creates an international and interdisciplinary research environment with many opportunities for collaboration and knowledge sharing. English is widely used as the working language in research and teaching, which makes it straightforward for international colleagues to integrate.

We offer access to advanced laboratory and workshop facilities and an environment where you can develop your academic profile through research, teaching and collaboration with both Danish and international external partners. As a workplace we value a collegial and inclusive culture with room for professional discussion, initiative and mutual support in everyday life. New colleagues, whether they come from elsewhere in Denmark or from abroad, can draw on the university’s support services related to relocation, housing and practical matters.

You can read more about AAU Energy at www.energy.aau.dk

**How to apply

**Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.

Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

**Salary and terms of employment

Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement).

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

The Plant Molecular Biology section at the Department of Molecular Biology and Genetics is seeking a highly motivated and ambitious postdoctoral researcher to join a dynamic and international research team. You will play a central role in advancing our understanding of the molecular dialogue between plants and their associated microorganisms, with the long-term goal of contributing to more sustainable and resilient agricultural systems.

The research team you will join is coordinating an international program that brings together leading scientists from around the world to investigate beneficial plant–microbe associations and harness their potential for sustainable food production.

Our focus is on uncovering the molecular mechanisms by which plants and microbes interact—ranging from early recognition events to colonization strategies. Within this framework, the advertised postdoctoral project is specifically focused on plant engineering for improved symbiotic associations with soil microbes. This knowledge forms the foundation for the development of novel solutions to reduce the need for chemical inputs and improve crop productivity, particularly in smallholder farming systems.

Your contributions will directly support the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs), especially those related to food security, sustainability, and climate resilience.

• Design, execute, and analyze experiments using molecular biology, plant transformation, gene expression, and phenotyping.
• Apply plant genetics and genomics to study mechanisms underlying plant–associated bacteria.
• Collaborate with international partners and contribute to joint research efforts within the program.

• Contribute to the supervision of MSc and PhD students, fostering an inclusive and supportive research environment.

Meet your future team

You will join the Industrial IoT Platform Team, part of IT & Digital Enablement. The team develops and maintains the shared IIoT platform that supports manufacturing applications through connectivity, data and reusable technical capabilities.

As IIoT Platform Technical Lead, you will provide day-to-day technical leadership across the engineering group. The role has no formal people-management responsibility.

What We Offer

This role combines contributing to the shared IIoT platform’s technical direction with direct engineering work. You will lead day-to-day technical direction and engineering execution, contributing to design, development, testing, reviews and complex problem-solving. You will turn product priorities into a coherent platform roadmap, engineering practices and clear guardrails.

You will balance a clear technical direction with close collaboration, involving the team in technical decisions and finding practical compromises that support both platform integrity and delivery needs.

The goal in this role means a clear and maintained platform roadmap, faster onboarding and greater reuse, improved visibility of platform health, and well-defined ownership between shared platform capabilities and domain-specific application logic.

Escalate material architecture and cross-platform decisions through the appropriate technical governance.

• Contribute hands-on to platform services and reusable components through design, development, testing and improvement. Focus your direct contribution where technical depth, complex problem-solving or delivery needs require it.

• Support platform observability, technical investigations and follow-through on incidents, problems and improvement actions in collaboration with the Operations Manager.

• Manage platform lifecycle health, including security, patching, vulnerability remediation, upgrades, documentation, supportability, and technical debt.

The role can be based in Skjern, Østbirk, Kolding or Hørsholm. Regular on-site presence in Skjern and at manufacturing locations in Denmark is required, along with occasional international travel. When tasks and projects allow, you may work from home up to two days per week.

• Bring practical knowledge across industrial connectivity and edge technologies, including MQTT, edge runtimes and container orchestration. You also understand industrial data contracts, observability or SRE practices, and OT cyber security.

• Can make practical technical design decisions while involving engineers and relevant stakeholders in finding workable solutions.

• Apply a platform mindset focused on reuse, self-service, consumer enablement, operational excellence and long-term maintainability.

At Apple, new ideas have a way of becoming phenomenal products, services, and customer experiences very quickly. The Creativity Apps team needs your help shaping the next generation of creative editing tools by working on state-of-the-art technologies to surprise and delight creative pros and enthusiasts alike. You’ll be working with the world-class teams behind Final Cut Pro, Logic Pro, iMovie, and GarageBand to create next-generation tools for creators!

Description

We're looking for a Performance Tooling Engineer to own the tooling and automated tests that keep our products fast, efficient, and correct. Your mission is to catch regressions before they ship, across latency, memory, power/thermals and functionality, by building the test harnesses, benchmarks, and CI infrastructure that make regressions visible, reproducible, and actionable.

The systems you build will run continuously across our device fleet and become the safety net our engineering team relies on. If you enjoy turning "it feels slower" into a hard number on a dashboard with a bisected culprit commit, this is for you.

Responsibilities

• Design, write, and maintain automated tests that detect performance regressions (latency, memory footprint, power consumption, etc.) and functional regressions.

• Build and operate CI pipelines and tooling that run these tests reliably across a fleet of hardware devices.

• Create dashboards, alerting, and triage tooling that surface regressions early and help engineers root-cause them quickly, e.g. automated bisection, historical trend tracking.

• Partner with cross-functional teams & leadership to define meaningful performance goals and acceptance criteria.

• Continuously improve test coverage, execution speed, flakiness, and the developer experience of running and interpreting tests.

Minimum Qualifications

• Very strong problem-solving and coding skills.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Experience building and maintaining CI systems.

• Solid understanding of performance measurement fundamentals: how to benchmark reliably, control for noise, and reason about latency, memory, and power/thermal metrics.

• Experience writing automated tests and the tooling/frameworks around them.

• Proven track record of integrating AI tools to enhance both personal productivity and team workflows.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience developing for Apple platforms (iOS/macOS), with working knowledge of Swift.

• Familiarity with the Apple development toolchain: Xcode, Instruments, and related profiling and testing.

• Experience with GPU programming and image processing systems (Metal, OpenCL, CUDA or similar).

• Experience with regression testing across many hardware devices, e.g., device labs, device farms, or fleet-based test automation.
